name: Keystones
description: Magical stones created by the Navi by distilling knowledge from the rings of the Eldarin Tree. Keystones open or connect to the different Arch realms of Atlas and are entrusted to keepers who are expected to actively use and protect them. Their creation unintentionally initiated the Mother’s Prayer.

log.summary: The Navi created the keystones by distilling knowledge from the rings of the Eldarin Tree, and their creation unintentionally initiated the Mother’s Prayer. The new keepers are expected to actively use and protect the keystones rather than simply hide them.
